name: Difficult Conversations at Work
summary:
Prepare for a difficult workplace conversation before you have it.

Learn with Rowan through short recorded lessons and readable panels. Practise describing facts and impact, asking and listening, acknowledging concerns while clarifying expectations, and agreeing a specific next step.

Rehearse one seated scenario with Alex, an AI employee whose two late reports delayed a client review. Speak naturally, explore what happened and work toward a plan. Review a concise coaching summary, retry a focused moment a
